title: A protocol to induce expandable limb-bud mesenchymal cells from human pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Place a 60-mm culture dish on the bench.
Pre-warm StemFit medium at room temperature.
Add 5 mL of StemFit medium supplemented with 10 μM Y-27632 to a 15-mL conical tube.
Thaw the vial containing hPSCs in 37°C water bath within 1 minute or until only small ice particles remain.
Disinfect the vial with 70% EtOH and transfer the cell suspension to the conical tube by gentle pipetting (1–2 times).
Centrifuge the cells at 1,500 rpm for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 1 mL of StemFit medium supplemented with 10 μM Y-27632.
Stain the cells with Trypan blue and count the cells using a cell counter.
Plate 1 × 10^4 cells/2 mL StemFit medium supplemented with 10 μM Y-27632 in one 60-mm culture dish.
Add 8 μL of iMatrix to a 60-mm culture dish with hPSCs.
Culture the dish at 37°C in 5% CO2 incubator.
Change to 3 mL of fresh StemFit medium without Y-27632 and iMatrix on the next day.
Replace the culture medium with StemFit without Y-27632 and iMatrix every 24–48 hours.
Observe the cells daily.
Change the culture medium every day until the next passage.
Culture the cells for 5–7 days before passaging.
Aspirate the culture medium when cells reach 70%–80% confluence.
Rinse the cells with 3 mL of PBS(-).
Apply and spread 500 μL of 0.5 × TrypLE Select/EDTA.
Incubate the cells at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Add 500 μL of StemFit medium containing 10 μM Y-27632 to strip cells.
Dissociate cell clumps into single cells by gentle pipetting approximately 10 times.
Transfer the cell suspension using a 1.5-mL microtube.
Count living cells using Trypan blue stain and a cell counter.
Seed 1 × 10^4 cells/2 mL StemFit medium containing 10 μM Y-27632.
Add 8 μL of iMatrix onto a 60-mm culture dish.
Gently agitate the culture dish to allow cells to disperse uniformly.
Place the culture dish in a 5% CO2 incubator at 37°C.
Culture hPSCs suspended in StemFit medium containing 10 μM Y-27632 and 4 μL of iMatrix for 24 hours at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Change to 1.5 mL of StemFit medium without 10 μM Y-27632 and iMatrix.
Aspirate the culture medium after culturing for 48 hours.
Wash the cells with PBS(-).
Apply 1.5 mL of the first differentiation medium into the 35-mm culture dish.
Aspirate the culture medium after culturing for 24 hours.
Wash the cells with PBS(-).
Apply 1.5 mL of the second differentiation medium into the 35-mm culture dish.
Aspirate the culture medium after culturing for 24 hours.
Wash the cells with PBS(-).
Apply 1.5 mL of the third differentiation medium into the 35-mm culture dish.
Culture for an additional 48 hours.
Observe cell morphology at each step under the microscope to validate cellular differentiation.
Assess the quality of LBM by FCM or PRRX1 immunostaining.
Aspirate the culture medium after 48 hours from changing to LBM medium.
Rinse cells carefully with PBS(-).
Apply 300 μL of Accutase and aspirate immediately.
Incubate the cells at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Strip the cells by adding 300 μL of ExpLBM medium.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 1.5-mL microtube.
Count living cells by staining with Trypan blue and using a cell counter.
Transfer 1 × 10^5 LBM cells into a fresh 1.5-mL microtube.
Centrifuge the cells at 7,000 rpm for 1 minute.
Suspend the cell pellet with 100 μL of 2% FBS/PBS(-).
Add 0.5 μL of each antibody including APC-CD44, BB700-CD140B, and FITC-CD49f.
Incubate the cell suspension for 1 h on ice.
Add 500 μL of 2% FBS/PBS(-) to the cell suspension.
Centrifuge the cells at 7000 rpm for 1 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and suspend the cell pellets with 2% FBS/PBS(-) containing 50 ng/mL DAPI (Thermo Fisher Scientific, D3571).
Analyze the cells by flow cytometry.
Coat a fresh 60-mm culture dish with 2 mL of 4 μg/mL fibronectin diluted in PBS(-) for at least 30 min at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Aspirate the fibronectin/PBS(-).
Add the ExpLBM medium to the coated dish.
Seed the 2 × 10^5 LBM cells suspended in a 3-mL ExpLBM medium onto fibronectin-coated culture dish.
Next day after plating, check the cell adhesion.
Change the culture medium every 2 days until the next passage.
Aspirate the culture medium when cells reach 70-80% confluency after 5-7 days of culturing.
Rinse the cells with PBS(-).
Apply 400 μL of Accutase to a 60-mm culture dish and aspirate immediately.
Incubate the cells at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Add 1,000 μL of ExpLBM medium to strip the cells.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 1.5-mL microtube.
Count living cells by Trypan blue stain using a cell counter.
Transfer 1 × 10^5 ExpLBM cells into a new 1.5-mL microtube.
Centrifuge the cells at 7,000 rpm for 1 minute.
Suspend the cell pellet in 100 μL of 2% FBS/PBS(-).
Add 0.5 μL each of FITC-CD90, BB700-CD140B, and APC-CD82 antibodies to the cell suspension.
Incubate the cell suspension for 1 hour on ice.
Add 500 μL of 2% FBS/PBS(-) to the cell suspension.
Centrifuge the cells at 7,000 rpm for 1 minute.
Aspirate the supernatant and suspend the cell pellets in 2% FBS/PBS(-) containing 50 ng/mL DAPI.
Analyze cells via flow cytometry.
Resuspend 1 × 10^6 ExpLBM cell pellets with 300 μL of STEM-CELLBANKER.
Dispense 300 μL of cell suspension to cryotubes.
Place cryotubes in BICELL freezer at -80°C for 24 hours.
Transfer cryotubes from BICELL freezer to a -80°C freezer or liquid nitrogen after freezing.
Prepare the ExpLBM cell suspension at a concentration of 70,000 cells/mL using an ExpLBM medium containing 10% FBS.
Seed 200 μL of cell suspension (1.4 × 10^4 cells) into each well of a 96-well flat culture plate.
Culture the cells for 3 days.
Wash the cells with PBS(-).
Add fresh STEP 1 medium to the wells.
Culture for an additional 6 days.
Change the STEP 1 medium after 3 days of culture.
Wash the cells with PBS(-) again.
Add fresh STEP 3 medium to the wells.
Culture for another 6 days.
Change the STEP 3 medium after 3 days of culture.
Prepare an ExpLBM cell suspension at a concentration of 5 × 10^5 cells/mL using STEP 1 medium.
Seed 200 μL of cell suspension (1 × 10^5 cells) into each well of a 96-well cell culture plate.
Centrifuge the plates at 2,000 rpm for 5 minutes.
Culture the cells for 6 days.
Change the medium to STEP 2 medium after 3 days.
Replace the culture media with fresh STEP 2 medium every 3 days for 6 days total.
Change the medium again to STEP 3 medium after an additional 3 days.
Replace the culture media with fresh STEP 3 medium every 3 days for a total of 42 days.
Change the medium every 3 days throughout the entire culturing period.
